text:
```yaml
name: Mark and close stale issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this issue should remain open, please leave a comment or remove the `stale` label. Thank you for your contribution!
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this PR should remain open, please leave a comment or remove the `stale` label. Thank you for your contribution!
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue was closed because it has been stale for 60 days and no further activity occurred.
            
            If you believe this issue should remain open, please reopen it or create a new one. Thank you for your contribution!
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was closed because it has been stale for 60 days and no further activity occurred.
            
            If you believe this PR should remain open, please reopen it or create a new one. Thank you for your contribution!
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-issue-stale: 90
          days-before-pr-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          days-before-issue-close: 60
          days-before-pr-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-pr-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed-by-stale'
          close-pr-label: 'closed-by-stale'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned'
          exempt-all-milestones: true
          exempt-all-assignees: true
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
```
